mapper.select:
select case when #{dimension} = 'project' then p.`ProjectName` when #{dimension} = 'user' then u.`RealName` when #{dimension} = 'tag' then dt.`TagName` else null end as `Dimension`, sum(t.`EstimatedHours`) as `EstimatedHoursSum`, sum(t.`ActualHours`) as `ActualHoursSum`, sum(t.`ActualHours`) - sum(t.`EstimatedHours`) as `Variance`, case when sum(t.`EstimatedHours`) > 0 then (sum(t.`ActualHours`) - sum(t.`EstimatedHours`)) * 100.0 / sum(t.`EstimatedHours`) else 0 end as `VariancePercent`
from `Task` t left join `Project` p on t.`ProjectID` = p.`ProjectID`
group by p.`ProjectID`
left join `User` u on t.`DevID` = u.`UserID`
u.`Role` = 3
group by u.`UserID`
left join `Tag_Relation` tr on t.`TaskID` = tr.`TargetID` left join `Dict_Tag` dt on tr.`TagID` = dt.`TagID`
tr.`TargetType` = 2
group by tr.`TagID`
1 = 2
order by `Variance` desc

select t.`DevID`, u.`DevName`, count(case when t.`Status` = 4 then 1 end) as `FinishedTasksCount`, case when count(case when perf.`Status` = 2 then 1 end) > 0 then sum(case when perf.`Status` = 2 then perf.`TotalScore` else 0 end) / count(case when perf.`Status` = 2 then 1 end) else 0 end as `TotalScoreAverage`, sum(t.`ActualHours`) as `ActualHoursSum` from `Task` t left join `Task_Performance` perf on t.`TaskID` = perf.`TaskID` left join `User` u on t.`DevID` = u.`UserID`
t.`Status` != 1
and t.`DevID` = #{userId}
and t.`DevID` in ( select t2.`DevID` from `Task` t2 left join `Project` p2 on t2.`ProjectID` = p2.`ProjectID` where p2.`PMID` = #{userId} and t2.`Status` != 1 )
group by t.`DevID`
